_comment: EGO gift keyword icons, keyed by the first 10 hex of the image sha256. A gift's keyword is either one of the seven statuses or one of the three attack types; the sheet writes '-' for gifts that are Keywordless, which is normal and not an error. Several copies of each glyph exist at different sizes — extract.py writes the highest-resolution variant. Identified by eye; see docs/pack-art.md for the equivalent note on pack art.
